items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I was the first one taking him and Peter on the job... Peter was playing the cornet... We had a four-piece band... Peter. Peter something. He used to play bass with us.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was playing violin. Yeah, playing violin.

Yeah, playing violin. Yeah. He didn't even tie it, but I never did. He used to come over there and play it when I was young, you understand? Mm-hm. Used to be around first. Well I was the first one taking him and Peeta on the job. He used to come over there and play when I was young, you understand? Used to be around the fest. Well I was the first one taking him and Peter on the job. Oh yeah? Fest. They was learning and I'd take them down the breakway in the cane cart. After grinding. I was the first one they…
Who else did you have in that band?

items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah, Peter and Peter. But now before you had Peter and then you had my father-in-law there... Piro and Peter and them had the boat.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. That way. That way. He had Peter. Fess. And. And. And. And. And. And. Uh. Nutzer Rubin. Who was that? Nutzer Rubin. What did he play? He played banjo. Guitar. Guitar. Yeah. They got guitar. They got guitar. Eddie Vinson playing trombone. And he was playing trumpet. Yeah. What did Peter play those days? Peter. Yeah. Peter was playing violin and trumpet like him. Yeah. That was around 1905 because I little fella peeping through the hole my mama and them was in there dancing and I'm peeping through the hole.
See, you were born in 96. Yes right. You were only about nine or ten years old, hardly ten years old. That's right.
